risks.title: Dependence on retention of key talent
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in HR strategy context (section Our People). Moderate language but repeated on succession planning and talent pipeline. Trend stable with 2024 focus on Thore Ohlsson succession. Category weight moderate for competitive sportswear sector.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance and emerging legislative risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Sustainability Committee focus on 'upcoming legislative projects'. Moderate but explicit language. Trend up with emphasis on future legislative project assessment. Category weight high for textile/HR sector subject to increasing regulations.

risks.title: Supply chain volatility and procurement risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited in audit report: 'market and procurement risks' among key supervised risks. Direct and repeated language. Trend stable but high intensity. Category weight very high for footwear/apparel manufacturer dependent on global suppliers.

risks.title: Intense competition in sportswear and footwear industry
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in strategic context (FOREVER.FASTER, 'largest-ever brand campaign'). Ambitious language suggesting competitive pressure. Trend up with 2024 focus on product innovation and marketing campaign. Category weight very high for highly competitive sector (Nike, Adidas, etc.).

risks.title: Dependence on retail sector performance and sales volatility
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned: 'turnover rate is intricately linked to the share of retail business in respective markets' (39% turnover retail vs 7% non-retail). Factual but revealing language. Trend stable. Category weight high for group with significant retail exposure.

risks.title: Diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in People First pillar: 'inclusive culture that respects diversity'. Moderate and positive language. Trend stable but inverse risk (reputation if non-compliance). Category weight moderate for sports brand exposed to societal expectations.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and HR/client data protection risks
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in extensive use of digital systems (Workday, Amber, Leena AI, LinkedIn Learning). Neutral language but high technology dependence. Trend up with increasing digitalization. Category weight moderate for group with sensitive HR and client data.

risks.title: Intellectual property and product counterfeiting risks
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in context of 'innovative products' and PUMA brand. Indirect language but sector highly exposed. Trend stable. Category weight high for luxury/sportswear brand with distinctive designs.
